header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

blocks.text: Relationships between Men, Women and Children
The Relationship between Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Sauda (RA)

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports, "I once brought Rasulullaah ﷺ some Hareerah that I had cooked. Sauda (RA) was sitting between between Rasulullaah ﷺ and I, so I told her to have some as well. When she refused, I said, 'If you do not eat, I shall smear it on your face.' She however still refused so I put my hand in the Hareerah and plastered it on her face. Rasulullaah ﷺ laughed as he put his hand in it saying, 'Now you smear her face.' Sauda (RA) then smeared it on my face and again Rasulullaah ﷺ laughed. Just then Umar (RA) passed by calling out for (someone called) Abdullaah. Thinking that he would soon enter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Get up and wash your faces!' Thereafter, I always stood in awe of Hadhrat Umar (RA) because of the respect Rasulullaah ﷺ had for him."

Another narration adds that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ lowered his knee for Sauda (RA) (to step on) so that she could get even with me. She then took some (Hareerah) from the dish and spread it on my face as Rasulullaah ﷺ laughed." [^1]
The Relationship Between Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) with Hadhrat Sauda Yamaaniyyah (RA)

Hadhrat Razeenah (RA) who was a freed slave of Rasulullaah ﷺ reports that Hadhrat Sauda Yamaaniyyah (RA) once visited Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) at a time when Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) was with her. Hadhrat Sauda (RA) arrived looking stunning and well-dressed with a Yemeni shawl and matching scarf. She also wore two spots of aloe and saffron on their places (near her eyes) which resembled two pimples. A narrator called Ulayla says that she found women beautifying themselves with aloe and saffron.

Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) said to Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), "O Ummul Mu'mineen! Rasulullaah ﷺ is due to arrive when this woman is gleaming here between us." "Fear Allaah, O Hafsah!" Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) warned. However, Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) said, "I am going to ruin her adornment for her." Hadhrat Sauda (RA) who was hard of hearing asked, "What are you two saying?" "O Sauda!" Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) said, "The one-eyed (Dajjaal) has appeared!" "Really!?" Hadhrat Sauda (RA) cried out. She was extremely shocked and started to shiver. "Where shall I hide?" she asked.
